Very impressive looking and much higher quality than a cheaper set of 3 (with glass lids) I had also bought at the same time. I would take the quality of these over the functionality of the glass lids every time. Pros: Gorgeous design, quality feel, sturdy, easy to setup, no water leaks, easy to clean. Food stayed nice and warm. Good sized water bowl. Cons: These are BIG. You will need plenty of space when using and storing. But so worth it. I haven’t used to put cool items in. Suspect condensation may be an issue, but would use outdoors.
